an imp attending Kālī, Kālac. v, 38.
(of ˚क, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 51; Pat.) a female imp attending Kālī (feeding on human flesh), BhP. x; BrahmaP.; MārkP.; Kathās. (डागिनी, cii, cviii f.) (cf. शाक्˚)
N. of a locality, ŚivaP. i, 38, 18.
डाकिनी—त्व n. the condition of a female imp, Daś. xi, 302.
